description: This file defines the 'Target' interface for connection targets in the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for retrieving target properties, JSON serialization, and nested JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Target
classes.description: Interface representing a connection target with methods for address, topics, QoS, authorization, headers, payload, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Target.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for Target properties such as address, topics, QoS, authorization context, acknowledgment label, header mapping, and payload mapping.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address for the configured type of signals of this target.

methods.name: getOriginalAddress
methods.description: Returns the original address before placeholders were resolved.

methods.name: withAddress
methods.description: Creates a copy of this object with the target address replaced.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns the set of topics to be published via this target.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns the optional QoS value of this target.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context of this target.

methods.name: getIssuedAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Returns the optional acknowledgement label to be automatically issued.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns the optional header mapping for outbound messages.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the payload mappings to be applied for messages sent on this target.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representation of this Target including only non-hidden marked fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns a JSON object for the specified schema version and field selector.
